key_insight: A pretrained autoregressive language model can be converted into a fast standalone multi-token predictor by training it with a simple online self-distillation objective, removing the need for auxiliary speculator models or complex inference pipelines.
problem_solved: Reduces autoregressive generation latency and deployment complexity by enabling a single pretrained model to predict multiple future tokens per forward pass without adding extra models or changing the runtime implementation.
method: Initialize from a pretrained autoregressive LM and keep the same model architecture and runtime.
Apply an online self-distillation loss that teaches the model to predict multiple future tokens (multi-token prediction) using its own next-token outputs as targets.
Train the model end-to-end so the final model can generate several tokens per step, enabling faster standalone inference without auxiliary speculators or complex pipelines.
impact: Simplifies production deployment and speeds up text generation by converting existing pretrained LMs into efficient multi-token generators while preserving the original implementation and avoiding extra models.
